huawei.facility: Huawei Cloud Ulanqab Phase 3 campus, contextual locator for DC5 fit-out
huawei.source_figure: 附图5 本项目四邻关系图
huawei.primary_property_label: 华为乌兰察布三期数据中心
huawei.marker_scope: Analyst-selected interior point of the government-map-labelled Phase 3 campus. DC5 building and floor position are not identified. Not a property centroid, entry, surveyed coordinate, parcel boundary or building footprint.
huawei.context_outline_scope: Visual tracing of the map shading solely to aid identity review; not a cadastral boundary and not proposed for publication as a polygon.
huawei.method: Fit separate linear longitude/latitude transforms to the printed geographic map grid; select an interior pixel; interpret unshifted geographic coordinates in WGS84 and cross-check roof/road/property arrangement against independent EPSG4326 Esri imagery. Esri corner measurements are checks, not fit inputs.
identity_observations: Three parallel west-side roofs, the west road and the south road separating Huawei from the VNET property match in both images.
The older EIA map labels the northern shaded property as Huawei Ulanqab Phase 3. The later georeferenced image contains additional east-side development; no phase or status is assigned to it.

excluded_eia_text_coordinate.reason: This is the neighbouring substation text coordinate and conflicts with the printed map grid. It is neither a Huawei coordinate nor a registration anchor. It is excluded entirely.

huawei.datum_and_uncertainty: The EIA map does not declare its datum. Direct interpretation of its graticule in WGS84 aligns the named property and three existing roofs with the independent Esri export. Manual grid/corner readings, source map scale, image geolocation, unknown acquisition dates and roof parallax prevent a defensible total accuracy value. The small visual offsets do not measure ground accuracy. No GCJ or other datum shift is inferred or applied.

vnet.decision: Accept labelled campus marker at the dedicated substation endpoint; no A2 footprint claim.

locator.precision: Campus marker at the published eastern feeder endpoint of the dedicated Zhilian No.1 substation on the north edge of the VNET zero-carbon base property, immediately south of Pingzan Street. It locates the named campus, not the A2 building, campus centroid, boundary, entrance or active-work footprint.
locator.identity_review: The EIA explicitly names the dedicated substation as part of 世纪互联乌兰察布零碳智算中心基地项目 (PDF28/printed21), publishes its incoming-line endpoints (PDF8/printed1), and shows the campus/substation south of Pingzan Street (PDF164/166). Its attached approval places the station in Yiwutang Industrial Park (PDF119/printed112). BUCG independently gives the four boundary roads. Google satellite inspection at the literal converted eastern endpoint matches the north-edge road intersection, field/tree pattern and east-side earthworks of the primary map. This is several kilometres southwest of the separate Bayin Cloud and AI phase1/2 location, whose conflicting coordinate is excluded.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The EIA publishes milliarcsecond coordinate digits but no explicit datum or positional accuracy. Values are converted from DMS without a datum shift; their interpretation on a WGS84 map is corroborated by the same physical pattern in satellite imagery, not by a datum declaration. This is a campus-level power-intake anchor; A2’s distance from it is unknown.

visual_review.observed_alignment: Literal eastern endpoint sits just south of the east-west road and west of the north-south road intersection, matching the primary route map’s user-substation entry. North-side woodland/field patterns and east-side earthworks align. Imagery is geometry corroboration only, not current construction evidence.
visual_review.excluded: Baidu construction-office POI and map viewport positions are discovery only and were not used for accepted coordinates; Bayin cloudAI station point not reused.
